Name: Programme and governance
Objective / description: Plan, scope, approvals and reporting
Key deliverables: Jira and sprint calendar, scope, architecture review, success and go/no-go criteria, CAB date
Exit criteria: Steerco agrees scope, plan and go-live criteria
Dependencies: Change freeze 11 Dec to 4 Jan; CAB calendar
Current state: Plan re-baselined on 9 Oct: two-week sprints, Sprint 3 from 20 Oct

Name: AOF platform on AWS: skeleton, UAT and Prod
Objective / description: The AOF orchestrator, its database and the reviewer console running on AWS, deployed through the pipeline to UAT and Prod
Key deliverables: AOF database (Postgres with pgvector), AOF orchestrator service, console at /agentone/finance, one way to take each AOF release, pipeline with tests and scans, UAT, Prod before the freeze
Exit criteria: The same build runs in UAT and Prod; Prod ready by 10 Dec
Current state: Sprint 2: database set up on AWS; AOF orchestrator deployment and the end-to-end skeleton in progress

Name: Agent One integration: sessions per capability per case
Objective / description: Agent One sessions are opened per capability per case (and per break group where needed), instead of per user login
Key deliverables: Session design, per-case sessions in Agent One, case identity and data scope, session lifecycle, model approval, tracing, cost limits
Exit criteria: Each FOBO case has its own Agent One session, shared by everyone working the case; no session per login
Dependencies: Model and data approval; Agent One team

Name: Data connections: MB Rec, MOTIF and FAS
Objective / description: Read breaks from MB Rec and bookings from MOTIF; post approved adjustments to MOTIF through FAS
Key deliverables: MB Rec and MOTIF connections, MB Rec end-of-day trigger, FAS posting of approved adjustments, user roles, Prod connections
Exit criteria: Breaks load from MB Rec; an approved adjustment posts to MOTIF through FAS in UAT
Dependencies: MB Rec, MOTIF and FAS teams; network rules

Name: FOBO (Helix) set-up with the FOBO controllers
Objective / description: FOBO Prime and Rates configured with, and confirmed by, the FOBO controllers who run the use case
Key deliverables: Thresholds, checks and verdicts, sign-off checklist, owners, which verdicts post adjustments
Exit criteria: The FOBO controllers confirm the set-up
Dependencies: FOBO controllers' time; MB Rec data

Name: Agent One Finance Diagnostics
Objective / description: Diagnostics service reading Phoenix traces, hosted outside AWS/BCP, improved each sprint
Key deliverables: Diagnostics core, hosting outside AWS/BCP, its own pipeline, UAT and Prod deployments, quality check against Phoenix, improvements
Exit criteria: Running in Prod; results match Phoenix
Dependencies: Hosting outside AWS/BCP; Phoenix read access
Current state: Sprint 1: about 70% built; Sprint 2: remaining items, own pipeline and deployment

Name: Governance, approvals and controls
Objective / description: Every approval and artefact AOF needs (TAC, ARB, CAF, CDO, DAIP, CARA, DPIA, AI risk) approved before the CAB request; controls built and tested. One team member owns the approvals.
Key deliverables: Artefact register; TAC, ARB, CAF, CDO, DAIP and CARA approvals; DPIA; AI and model risk assessment; posting controls; security scans; penetration test; access review
Exit criteria: All approvals and artefacts approved before the CAB request on 18 Dec
Dependencies: Forum calendars (TAC, ARB, CAF, CDO, DAIP, CARA); Risk and Security teams
Current state: Governance lead building the artefact register and booking TAC, ARB, CAF, CDO, DAIP and CARA dates

Name: Testing and parity with the FOBO controllers
Objective / description: Proof, by the FOBO controllers who run the use case, that it works at real volumes and matches today's FOBO
Key deliverables: Test plan, test books and dates, integration testing, parity check, performance test, UAT cycles 1 and 2 run by the FOBO controllers
Exit criteria: FOBO controllers sign off UAT; parity accepted; no open Sev1/Sev2
Dependencies: FOBO controllers' time; UAT environment and data

Name: Business engagement and showcase
Objective / description: FOBO controllers named and engaged; MB Rec and BA engaged; the controllers' skill-testing feedback used; working version shown on 30 Nov
Key deliverables: Named FOBO controllers, MB Rec working sessions and dates, BA requirements and UAT scenarios, interim skill-testing feedback, showcase, training
Exit criteria: Showcase held 30 Nov; FOBO controllers trained before go-live
Dependencies: FOBO controllers, MB Rec and BA availability
Current state: FOBO controllers testing their skill in finance agent chat; MB Rec and BA engagement starting

Name: Go-live and support
Objective / description: Safe release on 5 Jan and go-live on 14 Jan
Key deliverables: Runbook, support model, CAB, Prod release, monitoring, parallel run, go/no-go
Exit criteria: Live on 14 Jan with no open Sev1/Sev2; support in place
